issues.where: the splash crown left of centre and the drops above it
issues.what: the crown is a ring of flat pink cards with hard cut edges and no thickness or translucency, and the drops are opaque dark beads hanging in a neat arc; it reads as a cartoon splash at playing speed
issues.fix: simulate the splash as a thin translucent fluid sheet breaking into ligaments and droplets that pick up the sky and the red of the pool, with motion blur

issues.where: the clear dome on the pool right of centre (also set-A-07.png, small dome near the centre stumps)
issues.what: a perfect glass hemisphere with one round specular dot, no film colour, no wall thickness variation and no contact meniscus; it looks like a modelled dome sitting on the surface
issues.fix: give the bubble an uneven film with thin-film colour and pick-up of the red liquid, an irregular shape, a meniscus where it meets the surface, and a reflection that fits the overcast sky

issues.where: spray or mist on the left, x 0 to 17%, y 25 to 42% (also the haze in set-A-08.png and set-A-09.png)
issues.what: the spray is a field of discrete grey and pink dots laid over the plants like noise; the haze in other frames is grainy speckle rather than soft scattering vapour
issues.fix: render the spray as volumetric droplets with depth-of-field and forward scattering so it softens and lights up toward the light, and denoise the fog volume

issues.where: the stump bottom right and the cut stumps in the middle
issues.what: the open top of the right stump is a paper-thin shell with a flat brown interior and no wall thickness; the trunks share one bark texture with regular rings repeating
issues.fix: give the stumps a real wall thickness and fibrous broken interior, and vary the bark material and ring spacing per trunk

issues.where: the trunk, x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%
issues.what: two bark textures overlap with visible scale shapes ghosting through each other and a horizontal seam across the trunk
issues.fix: fix the UV seam and blend between layers so the bark reads as one continuous surface

issues.where: the flying creatures, x 42 to 58%, y 25 to 42%
issues.what: the fliers are flat dark silhouettes, one doubled into a smeared transparent ghost with streak lines that look like a compositing artefact rather than motion blur
issues.fix: render the fliers in 3D with proper motion blur, shading and haze attenuation by distance

issues.where: the shoreline crust, x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75% (also set-A-04.png foreground shore)
issues.what: the white crust is flat decal patches lying on the liquid surface, with no thickness, no wet dark edge and no meniscus where it meets the land
issues.fix: model the salt crust as raised crystalline rafts with a wet darkened margin, varied scale and reflection breakup around them

issues.where: the grey lumps lying on the flat, x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%
issues.what: the forms are noisy displaced blobs with rippled clay-like sculpt lines and no defined anatomy, legs or contact shadow; they read as unfinished meshes
issues.fix: either resolve them as clear animal bodies with weight, contact shadow and salt or wet on the hide, or as believable rock with crisp fractures

issues.where: the foreground rock bottom left (also set-A-06.png right crop)
issues.what: the rock has soft rounded clay-like lobes and a stretched blurry texture close to camera, with no fine fracture or grain
issues.fix: use higher-resolution, unstretched rock texture with sharp fracture edges and micro-detail at close range

issues.where: the large animal standing in the pool
issues.what: smooth uniform fur-shaded model look; legs enter the liquid with no ripple ring, no wet darkening and no splash or pickup of salt on the lower legs
issues.fix: add contact ripples and displacement where legs meet the liquid, wet darkened matted hair on the legs and belly, and salt crust spatter

issues.where: the brown fur lumps in the channel
issues.what: identical smooth fuzzy domes with near-identical neat concentric ripple rings, no wet line where they break the surface
issues.fix: vary shapes and poses, add a wet darkened band at the waterline and irregular ripples

issues.where: the flats, x 83 to 100%, y 25 to 42%
issues.what: the ground is soft and smeared, with stretched streaks of the same pink and grey texture and little detail
issues.fix: raise the texture resolution in the mid-ground and break up the repetition

issues.where: the liquid, x 42 to 58%, y 25 to 42%
issues.what: the dark red area has a fine digital grain and soft reflections that smear like a blur filter
issues.fix: increase samples on the liquid shader and add sharper small-scale ripple detail
